programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.2
programme.desc: Heilongjiang, China's northernmost province, is home to a veritable sea of trees, a forest forged by the Greater and Lesser Khingan Ranges. Beginning our Odyssey at its very northern extremity - a land of snowy Arctic snowscape and dazzling rime-frosts that's a paradise for winter-sports daredevils - we then head for Harbin and its spectacular ice festival in pursuit of some unique snowy adventures...

programme.title: Yangliuqing New Year Painting Art
programme.desc: On May 20, 2006, Yangliuqing New Year Paintings were named as part of China’s national intangible cultural heritage. The New Year painting tradition can be traced back many centuries, to the Ming Dynasty and beyond, reaching the height of its popularity in the Qing Dynasty. There are no restrictions on the themes of the paintings, and there is no blessing they cannot convey. Yangliuqing New Year Paintings are loved all over the country for their beautiful details and vivid colors—but most of all, for the good wishes they impart to anyone who sees them.

programme.title: The Tongliang Dragon Dance
programme.desc: The Tongliang Dragon Dance is a traditional performance art rooted in Chongqing’s Tongliang District, characterized by its elaborate dragon props and dynamic choreography. Originating in the Ming Dynasty and flourishing during the Qing, this vibrant folk tradition has regained its brilliance in modern times and earned international acclaim. The dance consists of two main branches: the dragon lantern dance—featuring forms like the Grand Wriggling Dragon, the Fire Dragon, and the Straw Dragon—and the festive lantern dance, which includes acts such as “Carp Leaps Over the Dragon Gate,” “Mudfish Eating Dumplings,” and “Three Dragons.” Steeped in cultural symbolism, the Tongliang Dragon Dance...

programme.title: Miao Embroidery: History in Stitches
programme.desc: According to legend, during a migration by the Miao ethnic group, a female chieftain wanted to keep a record of all the mountains and lakes she passed along the way. The means she chose of doing so was by stitching the images on her dress. By the time they reached a suitable place to settle, her clothing was covered with embroidered designs. This, it’s said, was the origin of Miao embroidery. As the story tells us, the designs in Miao embroidery are closely related to the natural world and daily life. The Miao people have a special fondness for nature. So, as well as depicting their daily farming and work activities, they copy birds, flowers, mountains, and grass onto their clothing. Over...

programme.title: Miao Silverware: A Shining Epic
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the fascinating world of the silver-working art of the Miao ethnic group. Join us, and hear the stories and see the works of four remarkable individuals. From a national-level inheritor who is preserving the traditional craft, to an artist infusing personal flair into his designs; from a female silversmith imbuing her work with feminine warmth, to a young artisan inspiring a new generation, we investigate the rich heritage, cultural significance, and evolving potential of Miao silverware.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Zaira (Argentina)
programme.desc: For a long time Zaira let herself be defined solely as a survivor of the traumatic sexual assault that marked her life. In her healing search, she left behind the busy city life and moved to seek solace in the mountains of Mendoza. It is among these magnificent peaks that Zaira found peace within herself and harmony with her surroundings. Now, eager to help others heal, she is the leader of a trekking initiative that doubles as a support group for other women who are victims of sexual aggression.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Ile (Argentina)

Her love for dance and desire for movement drove her to quit her corporate life and begin a new chapter as a fitness trainer. Quickly exhausting the traditional methods available at her local gyms, she began to create innovative and groundbreaking exercise methods of her own. Her goal: to empower women by making them feel strong and feminine at the same time.

programme.title: Earth from above - Season 2 - So the great rivers may live - Part 1
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 So the great rivers may live - Part 1
programme.desc: Water and its beauty, water and its power, water and its fragility... the water we all need is becoming scarce, through our own fault. Some rivers are dry, others are diverted, cut off by dams, others are simply polluted, and this for decades. We will discover how humans transformed the nature in Argentina, then in China and its disproportionate Three Gorges Dam. We will also go in Botswana with the Okavango, this unique river which flows into a desert forming the famous Okavango Delta. Vu du Ciel makes you discover once again another world, magnificent but threatened.

programme.desc: After twenty years as a lawyer, Carine decided to give in to her desire to help others heal. Her inner journey led her to discover a passion for naturopathy as she rediscovered her love for nature and learned the healing qualities of the plants around her. Combined with a deep understanding of astrology and nutrition, she is now able to help others live better and find their own path.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Virginie (Lyon)
programme.desc: Virginie’s beautiful handwritten lettering decorates the walls and windows of many shops in and around Lyon, France, as she lives out her passion of finding beauty in every stroke. A former waitress, Virginie was struggling to find her calling when she suffered a life-altering horse accident that almost left her handicapped. At only 30, she was forced to put her whole life into perspective. She finally found herself through a love for graphic design and lettering, combined with a desire for freedom that came with working independently. To motivate other women, she has also launched “Ladyboss”, a network of inspiring women entrepreneurs.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Laetitia (French Alps)
programme.desc: While pregnant with her daughter, Laetitia, a former journalist, experienced a strong desire to change lifestyles and move to the countryside. Remembering the teachings of her grandmother, she began to venture outdoors into the surrounding Alps and study the different plants at her fingertips. Today she holds a wealth of knowledge about the medicinal and aromatherapeutic value of plants that she applies to making natural products. With utmost respect for the environment, Laetitia gathers only what she needs in order to make herbal infusions.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Louise (Oleron Island)
programme.desc: At only 20 years old, Louise is full of confidence and already achieved a personal dream of hers to share her passion for nutritious and locally-sourced ingredients on the island of Oleron, France. Repurposing a camping car, she set up a brunch and tea-time spot where the guests can hand-pick their ingredients in the adjacent organic fields. Louise transforms the ingredients into favourite creations of hers and even joins her father for boat trips when she needs to stock up on fresh fish for the menu!

We head to Japan to talk about the impact of new technologies, then to the Republic of Congo in Bukavu for the coltan harvest. How does our total consumption affect the environment? What permanent brands are we imposing on our planet? How can we differentiate between useful and useless purchases?

programme.desc: Juliette has long been aware of the delicate beauty of nature. For years she spent her life on the sea, organising regattas for the traditional sailboats that are famous in the French region of Morbihan. Her appreciation for the elements made for a smooth transition as she decided to leave the water behind and return to the earth. Learning to shape a ball of clay into a graceful and elegant object, she discovered a passion for ceramics. programme.desc: Anna’s unusual background provided inspiration for her life change. Her career began as a wolf trainer for cinema and it was during these years that she developed her deep love for animals. After being tired of seeing them used as props and constantly in cages, she decided to leave the world of show business behind and start an eco-friendly sheep and goat pasture. To further share her passion for these gentle animals, Anna has opened a conservatory farm where visitors can experience first-hand the joys of being close to nature. She also makes amazing goat cheese!

This young and passionate sociologist decided to apply the same philosophy to her treatment as she did when surfing: when a wave crashes down on you, get up and try again. Through her healing journey she deepened her love for the ocean and also discovered the therapeutic capabilities of yoga for cancer patients. Today she shares her practice through surf and yoga retreats and is specialised in oncological yoga, helping others heal.

Her recent collaboration with luxury fashion house Loewe is a dream come true for this modern artisan.

programme.title: IL mare, essenza di una vita
programme.sub-title: IL mare, essenza di una vita
programme.desc: Conductor, composer, cellist and writer, Roberto Soldatini was born in 1960 in Rome. He challenged himself by combining his two greatest passions: music and the sea. In fact, since 2011, he lives alone on Denecia, his sailing boat, alternating every year six months of navigation in the Mediterranean to six months moored in the port of Naples for wintering. Being the first Italian citizen to take up residence in a boat, creating a legal precedent on this matter, is certainly one of the major causes for which he has fought, and for which he still stands, by providing support to those like him who would like to set their lives in a floating house. However, nowadays the most compelling challenges for him are the inner ones. With the advent of the mid-life crisis, he felt the need to share with others, to seek harmony with nature and above all, to rediscover the essential. A man who seeks his inner peace and the evolution of his consciousness through a particular choice of life.

programme.title: La linea de la memoria
programme.desc: Rafael works in the port of Cádiz. He is a ship captain who spent many years sailing. His father was a historian and together they wrote a great book on the history of the port of Cádiz. Miguel is Rafael's friend since childhood. He is a big fan of sailing and travel around the world twice. The two protagonists are determined that the city of Cádiz recovers its glorious historical memory. Especially, the part concerning one of the most interesting episodes related to the Sea: the history of the Meridian of Cádiz (“zero Meridian”), valid for one hundred years in the eighteenth century for all the navigators of the world. Throughout the documentary, we know Rafael and Miguel and also their activities aimed at enhancing the history of the city. Finally, a group of students, in a very eye-catching action, “draw” with a red cloth the ancient meridian on the streets, squares and roofs of the city.

programme.desc: Known as Druk Yul or the “Land of the Thunder Dragon”, Bhutan is the country of mountains, monasteries and mystery. programme.title: 10 Days Scotland
programme.desc: Robbie’s journey to reconnect with his Scottish roots begins in Edinburgh, the stunning capital city perched on extinct volcanoes. Navigating the twists of the Royal Mile, strutting around the majestic Edinburgh castle and learning to sip scotch like a true Scotsman, he feels a tad closer to his heritage. The real fun kicks in, however, when he stumbles onto a rather flamboyant way to unleash his inner Highlander.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.desc: Like Rome, Plovdiv straddles seven hills; but as Europe’s oldest continuously inhabited city, it’s far more ancient. As Catriona takes a tour of the city to see its iconic attractions such as a Roman Amphitheatre, which was once the setting for gladiator fights, and the striking Baroque Saints Constantine and Helena Church, she begins to see how seamlessly modern life blends with the age-old ruins. Along the way, she realizes why Plovdiv is called the ‘Eternal City’ of Bulgaria.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.sub-title: S04 : E128 Jodha Akbar S4 E128
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: After his Duel with Shark, Yuma Duels Tetsuo Takeda without "Numbers" and loses twenty times in a row, with Tetsuo angry because Yuma lied about not using the "Numbers" against Shark. Yuma is scolded by Astral on his immaturity. On the other hand, Shark returns to "his place" where he gets involved with a criminal network. Yuma, who knew what was going on with Shark, challenges the two strongest thugs: Rikuo and Kaio, to what Shark proposes to be a 2 on 2 "Tag-Team Duel".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma finds himself pinned down by the overwhelming power of "Number 61: Volcasaurus". To protect their precious remaining Life Points, he defends Shark at his own expense. When their opponents summon their second Number monster at that point, Astral becomes aware of the hidden mysteries underlying the Duel. In a last-ditch effort, Shark notices Yuma's passion and entrusts him with 1 card that could turn the whole Duel around!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 The Number Hunter - Part 1
programme.desc: After a series of incidents, Yuma and Astral learn of the existence of a "Number Hunter". Astral remains wary of an unseen presence, but Yuma pretends not to care. As a result, a series of strange phenomena appear around these two. Undeniably, these are the signs of the coming of the "Number Hunter" named Kaito Tenjo. At that moment, a dangerous Duel with the Numbers cards on the line begins. With Kaito's power far beyond their reckoning, what can Astral or Yuma possibly do?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 The Number Hunter - Part 2
programme.desc: In just 1 Turn, Kaito Summons 2 Numbers. Yuma attempts to resist the onslaught, but all of his monsters have been removed from the field...! Kaito, capable of even more, summons the strongest Monster to exist: "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon", which has never been seen before! Yuma summons "Number 39: Utopia" to create a turnaround despite the impossible odds facing him.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Having clearly seen Kaito's power, and how utterly hopeless they are, Yuma and Astral are keenly aware that they cannot easily recover. At that time, Yuma talks to his grandmother. She mentions a mysterious old man named Jurou at a "Duel Lodge" who owns a wooden statue of the Legendary Monster "Dark Magician", who is waiting for Yuma and his crew. Yuma makes a strong wish based on his desire to train and get better!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: It's a Duel against Jurou's former disciple, Yamikawa! Yamikawa draws his Ninja monsters, pinning Yuma down, but believing in the power of his friends, Yuma must continue this battle to the Death! But, Yamikawa summons his Trump Card, the Number Monster "Armed Ninja - Crimson Shadow"! However, Yuma continues to believe in the power of his friends, but can this possibly lead him to win the Duel!?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E17 It's in the Cards - Part 1
programme.desc: Kotori and her friends, who are interested in the Number cards, plus Astral, form the "Number Club". To get more info about the Numbers, they visit the home of a fortuneteller, but the fortuneteller is under the orders of Kaito to collect the Number Cards! When the fortuneteller, Jin, kidnaps Kotori and the rest, Yuma and Astral come to the rescue, but the memory of their Duel with Kaito comes back, the visions of which continue to haunt them!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E18 It's in the Cards - Part 2
programme.desc: To save Kotori and the rest, Yuma continues to fight with Jin over the Numbers. With the feelings of these two guys, "Utopia" obtains a new power!

Not having reconciled in over 2 days, suddenly Number 96 swallows Yuma and Astral up!! To rescue Yuma and Astral from Number 96, Tetsuo fights the Numbers for the first time!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: In order to protect Yuma's Key from Kite, Shark faces him in a Duel.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E23 Hunting Down the Hunter - Part 1

At that time, Kite, using Dr. Faker's technology, retraces Astral's memories and invites Yuma to the World Duel Carnival.

This sets Detective Lazarus on a wild goose chase to find what appears to be a package determined not to be found and a carrier who appears to no longer exist.

programme.title: Benefit Boys

Help comes in the form of her neighbour, a yahoo-yahoo boy who masquerades as a native doctor, but when the chief’s body disappears, what was a previous case of small trouble suddenly becomes double wahala.

programme.title: We Tha Boyz
programme.desc: Four jolly teenagers decide to help their friend, Tokunbo, in his plans to get the love of Chioma, however, a rival gang is also vying for her attention. Tokunbo’s parents go out of town and they decide to throw the ultimate house party to impress her. As simple as the plan seems, in reality however, they get in several problems in order to pull it off and end up almost ruining the house.

programme.title: Omini Power

programme.title: Femi

programme.desc: Join us every week on the AMC couch as we talk to the biggest movers and shakers in the buzzing industry. We are putting you in the know with all things in African and Nollywood cinema actors, actresses, directors, producers, classic cinema and soon to be blockbuster hits it's all here on AMC Movie Talk.

programme.title: Humble Pie
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. A down-on-their luck couple turn to a life of crime, calling themselves Bonnie and Clyde, when the man loses his job due to unfortunate circumstances. Their crimes lead them to a bickering couple, Eric and Zara, and this chance meeting has everyone re-evaluating their actions.

programme.title: Surviving Gidi Ep5
programme.desc: The sitcom centres around the lives of four main characters living in Lagos and Nigeria, who, on a everyday basis, strive to live a good life amidst challenges, hustling, and some favourable and unfavourable conditions. The story touches love, emotions, intrigues and generally, laughter.

programme.title: Surviving Gidi Ep6
programme.desc: The sitcom centres around the lives of four main characters living in Lagos and Nigeria, who, on a everyday basis, strive to live a good life amidst challenges, hustling, and some favourable and unfavourable conditions. The story touches love, emotions, intrigues and generally, laughter.

programme.title: Believers
programme.desc: Lulu tries to make ends meet after her father passes aways but things are not easy for her. Her friends try to convince her that the only way to get money is to sell her body but she is determined to find another way.

programme.title: Just Too Close
programme.desc: Two cousins find out they are in a relationship with the same guy, and things get even more complicated when one of them becomes pregnant. Will she keep the baby?

programme.title: Judgement
programme.desc: A newly-elected politician is at loggerheads with colleagues and his family as he fights all the corruption around him.

programme.title: Northwest Trail
programme.desc: Mountie Matt OBrien assignment is simple: He is to escort the rather grouchy, and slightly annoying, Miss Katherine Owens to a remote outpost. Things complicate however when they arrive at the outpost and he stumbles upon an illegal mining operation. Stars include Bob Steele, Joan Woodbury, and Poodles Hanneford.

programme.title: Over the Hill Gang
programme.desc: A retired Texas Ranger and his three aging pals are hired to clean up a lawless town. Starring Walter Brennan, Edgar Buchanan, Andy Devine, Jack Elam, Gypsy Rose Lee, and Rick Nelson.

programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trailblazer
programme.desc: Daniel Boone (Bruce Bennett) battles Shawnee warriors as he leads a band of settlers into Kentucky in this frontier potboiler from Albert C. Gannaway Productions. Made at the height of Hollywood's fascination with pioneer days, the film also stars Lon Chaney Jr. as Chief Blackfish, and country singer Faron Young as a handsome young suitor for Boone's daughter. There's plenty of action and danger here as the Shawnee are convinced that Boone is trying to steal their land. But Boone is ready, not even fearing death by tomahawk. It isn't how you die, Boone says. It's what you live for.

programme.title: Buffalo Stampede
programme.desc: A big time cast, including Randolph Scott, Buster Crabbe, Barton MacLane, and Harry Carey star in this feature about stampedes, Indian attacks, and plundering thieves! Directed by the esteemed Henry Hathaway (True Grit, Niagara).

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this vintage western. He and George Gabby Hayes strike it rich with a gold mine, only to find their lives complicated by women and crooked officials. Things get even messier when the good guys are framed for murder! Its all action here, particularly since legendary stuntman Yakima Cannut stars as one of the films heavies. Who will win the fight over the gold and the girl? Directed by Robert N. Bradbury for Monogram Pictures. Also starring Barbara Sheldon. (The film was also known as Gold Strike River.)

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is in search of a missing miner and his daughter in this Lone Star Picture. Along the way, Drew rescues his pal Wabbi (Noah Beery Jr.) from card cheats who have framed him for murder. You'll find plenty of action and suspense in this vintage horse opera, originally distributed by the kings of the B western, Monogram Pictures!

programme.title: Riders of Destiny
programme.desc: John Wayne sings! Well, not really. His voice was dubbed here, but as Singin Sandy Saunders hes still able to write the code of justice with a blazing sixgun! Hes a government agent out to help a group of ranchers in their battle with a villain who is tying up local water rights. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Al St. John, Yakima Canutt, and Cecilia Parker, Riders of Destiny was filmed early in Waynes career it was his first for Lone Star but the unmistakable swagger is already in place!

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: Dad Longworth robs a Mexican bank, takes the loot, and leaves his partner Rio to be captured. However, Rio escapes capture and searches for Dad in California.

programme.title: Between Men
programme.desc: When his young son is shot, John Wellington kills the culprit and flees. But his son Johnny recovers and is raised by Sir George. Some twenty years later Johnny sets out to find Sir George's missing granddaughter. He finds her and also finds Rand, but neither of the two men realize they are father and son.

programme.title: Ghost Town Gold [The Three Mesquiteers]
programme.desc: CAVALIERS OF THE CACTUS COUNTRY--ALWAYS READY FOR A FIGHT OR A FROLICK! The second entry in what would grow into a wildly popular series of Western Three Mesquiteers B-Movies produced by Republic Pictures, Ghost Town Gold tracks the titular trio as they attempt to recover the gold stolen by a gang in its effort to ruin the bank/mayor who ordered them to leave town. Frequent John Wayne collaborator Joseph Kane adds his signature directorial panache to this rousing shoot-em-up, setting the tone for a film series that was so rampantly successful, it spawned 50 sequels and a host of imitators from rival studios.

programme.title: The Gunman from Bodie
programme.desc: The Rough Riders, a popular group that thrilled audiences in the early 1940s, are after a gang of rustlers in this B-western from Hollywood's Poverty Row. Starring Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, and Raymond Hatton, this movie features everything from lawmen going undercover to the Rough Riders looking after an orphaned baby! Also, be on the lookout for the beautiful Christine McIntyre, who would go on to appear in several of the Three Stooges shorts for Colombia Pictures.

programme.title: Fighting Fury
programme.desc: A THRILLING TALE OF REVENGE AND REDEMPTION! Based on the story Triple Cross for Danger by the widely lauded Western author Walter J. Coburn, Fighting Fury is a thrilling take on the Western revenge drama. Portraying both a father and his son, star of silent and sound cowboy adventure films, Jack Hoxie (Trouble Busters, Law and Lawless) exudes the classic American rustic charm that still defines the genre. The film spins the yarn of Clay Hill Jr. (Hoxie), a Spanish-American boy raised by a Mexican servant who vows bloody vengeance on three malicious ranchers after they murder his parents and turn his life upside down. Featuring fine supporting performances from genre heavies Helen Holmes,...

programme.title: Springtime in the Sierras
programme.desc: Ads for this Roy Rogers classic roared HEAD FOR THE MUSICAL HILLS...ROY IS GUNNIN' FOR THRILLS! And thrills are what you'll get when you watch this fun, action packed B-Western from Republic Pictures. There's some great comic relief from Andy Devine and Chester Conklin, two of Hollywood's all-time greats. This old-fashioned shoot-'em-up was directed by William Witney, who would go on to direct many of television's top western sagas, including Bonanza, Wagon Train, and The Wild, Wild West.

programme.title: The Two Gun Man
programme.desc: Ken Maynard stars in this vintage western about ranchers under threat from hired gunmen. Director Phil Rosen, whose career dated back to working with Thomas Edison and included several Charlie Chan features, keeps the action hot with help from a strong ensemble, including Charles King, Murdock MacQuarrie, and a horse named Tarzan! Maynard plays Blackie Weed, a marshall going undercover to capture and arrest some cattle rustlers.He finds himself up against some very bad men, and he's soon framed for murder. Watch as Blackie blazes his way to vindication with a .45 in either hand and the flame of righteous anger in his eyes... Kitty: Nita Martin. Joe Kearney: Lafe McKee. Lem Tolliver: Tom...

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat and Stoney are ordered to Wisconsin to investigate an Indian agent's claim that a lumber company is forcing the Chippewa Indians off their reservation in order to harvest pristine stands of pine trees. The G-Men's investigation is hindered by the distrust of the Chippewas as well as the lumbermen. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. In this episode, Pat and Stoney are ordered to California to investigate reports of an anthrax epidemic and get involved in murder and a feud between neighboring ranchers. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat and Stoney are ordered to San Pablo, Mexico, to find out what's behind the trouble an American tungsten mine is having. When they arrive, they discover the mine has been closed, the wells are all poisoned and the town is in the grip of a malaria epidemic. To make matters worse, the lawmen have been followed by four gunslingers determined to give the American troubleshooters all the trouble they can handle - and more. Russell Hayden stars.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. In this episode, Pat and Stoney tangle with a gang of robbers who have hijacked an Army payroll. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan. Originally aired on NBC.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Billie Jo recieves an endowment, but instead of using it for medical school, she wishes to go to Hollywood.Kate meets with Judge Drucker to see if she can legally prevent the girl from goinng. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Directed by Jean Yarbrough.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E19 Visit from a Big Star
programme.desc: A famous movie star (John Vivyan) stays at the Shady Rest Hotel. He wants to get away from the spotlight for a while, but it appears that Uncle Joe has told the entire valley that the hotel has a special guest. .Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Directed by Ralph Levy. Episode first aired January 28, 1964

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Uncle Joe tries to convince two rich women that Shady Rest is a farm. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Directed by Guy Scarpitta..Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aried in February of 1964.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E21 The Very Old Antique
programme.desc: Homer Bedloe (Charles Lane) tries to sell the Cannonball to a rich man as an antique.Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Directed by Jean Yarbrough. Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1964.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Dave Morgan, an honest lawyer, faces off with Carter Holmes, a crooked politician, in a fiery election campaign. Things take a turn for the worse when Holmes attempts to have his opponent killed. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Looking through an old trunk, Tagg and his friend Johnny Ward, the son of a murdered lawman, find proof that his uncle is an ex-convict and may be involved in a recent bank robbery. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: The bank is robbed and the sheriff is killed while everyone is distracted by the wedding between Sand Creeks newspaper editor and a beautiful brunette. The sheriff being the editors best man, the grief-stricken editor begins to escalate the anger towards a suspected drifter with his bias reporting. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie is on the case when homesteaders are forced to sell their land for cheap due to suspicious circumstances. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Tagg Oakley finds himself in trouble after being tricked into driving a wagon full of gunpowder to Fort Yuma, unaware that Geronimo and his Apache braves are waiting for the wagon to pass. Realizing Tagg is in danger, Annie and Lofty race to the rescue. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie writes to the son of an old female pedlar, unaware that he is a member of an outlaw gang, now on their way to Diablo. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. Also starring Slim Pickens. This entertaining western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.sub-title: S03 : E23 The Saga of Clement O' Toole
programme.desc: Mistaken for a notorious outlaw, a young man struggles to convince the townspeople that he didnt commit a stagecoach robbery. Initially, Annie and Susan Meriwether believe him, but his innocence comes into question when he is present during a bank robbery in which the outlaws seem to recognize him. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: With the sheriff off looking for an outlaw, a fake sheriff takes his place, leading to a senseless murder. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This enetertaining western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award in 1955.

programme.title: Kentucky Rifle
programme.desc: His Wits, Weapons and Women, Turned Defeat Into Victory! A man brings a wagonload of Kentucky rifles through Indian Territory. Unfortunately the Indians realize what he has and offer the travelers an ultimatum: the rifles or their lives! Starring Lance Fuller, Sterling Holloway, Henry Hull, Chill Wills, Cathy Downs, and Jeanne Cagney, plus one of the great B-Western heels, I. Stanford Jolley!

programme.title: Daniel Boone
programme.desc: In 1775, Daniel Boone (George O'Brien) leads thirty colonial families to Kentucky where they face the threats of Native American marauders led by rebel Simon Girty (John Carradine). That's just the beginning, for there are even more dangers and clashes ahead for Boone and his party. With a cast that includes Ralph Forbes, Heather Angel, and lovable child star Dickie Jones, director David Howard takes us through one of the most exciting periods in American history!

programme.title: Lawless Frontier
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this vintage western about a man avenging the murder of his parents. Other cast members include frequent Wayne sidekick George 'Gabby Hayes', plus Yakima Canutt, Sheila Terry, and Jack Rockwell. This Paul Malvern Production from director Robert N. Bradbury also features Earl Dwire, one of the great B-movie villains, as Zanti, the ruthless bandit who sets the action in motion.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: Undercover US Marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is investigating a rash of robberies by a character known as The Polka Dot Bandit in this B-movie gem. Along the way, Carruthers finds himself in more trouble than he'd ever expected! Written and directed by Robert N. Bradbury, the film features George Gabby Hayes, Eleanor Hunt, and many other favorites of the era. Wayne was only 27 at the time of Blue Steel, but was well on his way to becoming The Duke.

programme.title: Man from Utah
programme.desc: WHIRLING ROPES AND SNARLING GUNS IN THE GALLOPING GRIP OF A GLAMOROUS DRAMA! John Wayne stars as John Weston, a man hired to investigate shady doings at a local rodeo. It seems all the riders who are on the verge of winning end up dead. Along with Wayne, this tale of action on the range also stars the usual Lone Star Picture stock company, including Gabby Hayes and Yakima Canutt!

programme.title: The Outlaw
programme.desc: Billy the Kid, Pat Garrett, and Doc Holliday ride again in Howard Hughes' epic 1943 western, but the character you'll remember most is sultry country vixen Rio McDonald. Hughes' nationwide search for an actress to play Rio resulted in the film debut of Jane Russell, whose natural assets were allegedly helped by a special bra designed by Hughes. When The Outlaw finally received a nationwide release in 1946, its success vindicated Hughes and made Russell a star. As for Hughes' infamous bra, Russell said in her 1988 memoir, I never wore it, and he never knew.

programme.title: Clearing the Range
programme.desc: Hoot Gibson stars in this reworking of the Zorro legend with a western setting. For trivia buffs: Hoot was married to his leading lady, Sally Eilers, at the time this film was released.

programme.title: Adventures of Gallant Bess
programme.desc: Rather than a gorgeous Hollywood starlet, actor Cameron Mitchell (Carousel), playing cowboy Ted Daniels, shares the screen in this film with a magnificent wild horse named Gallant Bess, who he tames, trains and keeps for himself. But after Ted is gravely injured in a fixed rodeo, Bess is stolen away from him and forced to join a cruel traveling carnival in this fast-paced western from director Lew Landers (The Adventures of Rin Tin Tin).

programme.title: The Fighting Redhead
programme.desc: When a rustler named Faro kills one of his own henchmen and blames it on Sheila O'Conner, Red and Little Beaver set out to clear Sheila and to find evidence against Faro and his gang.

programme.title: Broadway to Cheyenne
programme.desc: A gang of big-city thugs trying to set up a protection racket out west meet their match in this B-Western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Rex Bell, billed on the old print ads as The heroic idol of young America! stars as Breezy Kildare, a New York detective who happens to be in Wyoming. When Breezy leads a group of cattleman against the well-armed city boys, the bad guys will wish theyd stayed in New York! The rest of the cast includes such favorites from the period as George Gabby Hayes, Roy DArcy, and Marceline Day. (Day worked opposite everyone from John Wayne to Buster Keaton, but retired from acting shortly after this movie at age 25.) Directed by Harry L. Fraser.

programme.title: Raiders of the Border
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Nevada Jack McKenzie (Johnny Mack Brown) and Sandy Hopkins (Raymond Hatton) go undercover to catch jewelry smugglers in this vintage western from Monogram Pictures. This was one of the last films directed by John P. McCarthy (Song of the Gringo, The Oklahoma Cyclone), while Johnny Mack Brown would go on to find great success as Nevada Jack; this was the fourth of 19 films where he played the crime busting marshal.

programme.title: Neath Canadian Skies
programme.desc: It's the mounties versus claim jumpers in this drama from Golden Gate Pictures. Based on an action-packed novel by James Oliver Curwood and directed by B. Reeves Maynard (Undersea Kingdom, The Phantom Empire), the film features an outstanding cast of Poverty Row regulars, including Russell Hayden, Inez Cooper, Cliff Nazarro, I. Stanford Jolley, and Kermit Maynard. For movie buffs: Cinematographer Marcel Le Picard began his career in the silent era and finished with exactly 200 credits!

programme.title: Fugitive of the Plains
programme.desc: In this continuation of the much loved Billy the Kid serials featuring dreamboat Buster Crabbe (perhaps best known for his numerous appearances as Flash Gordon in the 30s and 40s), Billy finds himself joining an outlaw band led by women in order to, once again, clear his name after being wrongly accused of a crime he did not commit. Helmed by famed B-movie director Sam Newfield, this film also features Al St. John, whose lovable Fuzzy character was as essential to the PRC's Billy the Kid series as Billy himself.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: In an episode called Koniakers, G-Men Pat Gallagher and Stoney Crockett investigate how U.S. currency in a bank vault was replaced by counterfeit money. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West. In this episode, Pat and Stoney get reports that a man is selling salted mines to investors. The two G-men are determined to discover the truth. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, sent by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. In Mysterious Decoy, Pat and Stony get involved with the famous half-way house that settled the Utah-Arizona boundary. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan. In this episode, the boys rout out Ole Gimpy's ghost.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Spur Line to Shady Rest
programme.desc: The Shady Rest hotel is threatened when a railroad detective comes to investigate a forgotten spur line on the property. Creator Paul Henning followed up the success of The Beverly Hillbillies with this charming CBS comedy that ran for 222 episodes. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Quick Hide the Railroad
programme.desc: Kate uses her charms to keep Homer Bedloe from catching the train to Pixley. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Bedloe: Charles Lane. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.desc: After Harry T. Collier, a beloved commissioner of Indian Affairs, is murdered in late March during the1880s, Captain Apache, an Indian graduate of West Point, is assigned by the army to investigate the crime. Suspecting that O.J., the sheriff of a town bordering the reservation may be involved in the killing, Apache travels there and finds the sheriff dining with his mistress Maude at the Paradise Saloon. Before Apache can question him, however, O.J. abruptly departs and rides out of town with Apache in pursuit. When Apache apprehends him, O.J. swears that he did not kill Collier and relates that the agents dying words were April Morning. Meanwhile, Griffin, a wealthy landowner and six of...

programme.title: Rawhide
programme.desc: Baseball superstar Gehrig is one of several ranchers being coerced by a bunch of bandits. His sister and her lawyer/lover organize the ranchers. Directed by Ray Taylor; starring Smith Ballew, Gehrig, Evelyn Knapp. Talk about stunt casting! Gehrig was a New York Yankees star who was nearing the end of his career, but one of the biggest sports stars in the country. In the movie he plays a variation of himself, as Lou Gehrig, a retired baseball player who takes up ranching. Lou expects to relax on his ranch but quickly joins other ranchers in a fight to protect their properties.

programme.title: The Dawn Rider
programme.desc: John Wayne was still a few years from major stardom when he appeared as John Mason, a man seeking revenge for his fathers murder. Marion Burns stars as Alice, Masons love interest, while Reed Howes stars as Masons friend and rival for Alices affection. When Mason finally tracks down the man responsible for his fathers death, will Ben help, or stand in his way? Produced by Lone Star Pictures, the group behind many of Waynes early films, The Dawn Rider is a stirring yarn about the price of vengeance.

programme.title: Winds of the Wasteland
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this Republic Pictures western about the final days of the Pony Express. Former rider John Blair (Wayne) enters a coach race to win a $25,000 government mail contract, but there are dozens of obstacles in his path. The rest of the cast includes Lane Chandler and Phyllis Fraser, plus Lew Kelly (Lady of Burlesque) doing a great comic turn as Rocky OBrien, the eccentric, self-proclaimed mayor of a deserted mining town.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: He Dared Death In The Outlaw's Lair! John Travers (John Wayne) takes on a mysterious gang leader known as The Shadow in this vintage western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Director/writer Robert N. Bradbury (Blue Steel, Riders of Destiny) gets the best of a remarkable cast that includes George Gabby Hayes. Of interest to film buffs is that the feature was shot in various California locations by Oscar winning cinematographer Archie Stout (The Quiet Man).

programme.title: Bottled with Love
programme.desc: Abbey er midt i sin karriere, ulykkelig, frustreret og håbløst opgivende efter alle sine mislykkede dates. Hendes mormor foreslår, at hun skriver alle sine ønsker som et kærlighedsbrev lige fra hjertet. Modvilligt følger hun rådet og putter brevet ned i en flaske, som hun kaster ud i havnen.

programme.title: Step Up Revolution
programme.desc: Rigmandsdatteren Emily er ny i Miami, da hun møder den hotte danser, Sean. Han står i spidsen for flash mob-crewet, THE MOB, der gang på gang forvandler byens gader til den vildeste gadefest!

programme.title: Walking on Sunshine
programme.desc: Alle de største hits fra 80'erne er samlet i denne romantiske perle af en komediemusical, som udspiller sig på den skønne, italienske riviera. Taylor skal til sin søsters bryllup, men hun vil snart opdage, at brudgommen ikke er hvem som helst...

programme.title: Kærlighedens historie
programme.desc: Der var engang en dreng ved navn Leo, der elskede en pige ved navn Alma. Han lovede at få hende til at le hele livet igennem. Men krigen skilte dem ad.

programme.title: The Way You Look Tonight
programme.desc: Peter nærmer sig 30 og er stadig på jagt efter kærlighed med endeløse online-dates uden resultat. En gådefuld date efterlader ham alene i sengen en morgen, da han vågner. Peter forsøger at lægge alt bag sig og fortsætter med nye dates fra samme site.

programme.title: Miss Julie
programme.desc: Miss Julie er baseret på August Strindbergs skuespil. Frøken Julie er overklassekvinden som en midsommernat i slutningen af 1800-tallet forfører sin fars tjener. Hun er hovmodig og ude efter at ydmyge, han er poleret, men rå.

programme.title: Sleeping With Other People
programme.desc: Kan to personer, der dyrker serie-utroskab, få en chance til for at finde kærligheden? Efter en engangsaffære i college møder Lainey og Jake hinanden tilfældigt 12 år senere. De opdager, de har det samme problem: Ingen af dem kan holde liv i et forhold.

programme.title: Then Came You
programme.desc: THEN CAME YOU er historien om Skye (Maisie Williams), en kæk teenager med en dødelig sygdom, og Calvin (Asa Butterfield), en 19 år gammel hypokonder, der er bange for sin egen skygge.

programme.title: No Stranger Than Love
programme.desc: Hvad kan være mærkeligere end det hul, der opstår i Lucy Sherringtons stuegulv? Svaret viser sig at være kærlighed.

programme.title: Programmerne genoptages snart
programme.desc: Vi er ved at indhente vores skønhedssøvn! Bliv hængende for mere uvurderlig underholdning udvalgt af Rakuten TV.

programme.title: That Awkward Moment
programme.desc: Hvad er bedre end at være single i New York? Zac Efron, Miles Teller og Michael B. Jordan har en pagt om at undgå parforhold for enhver pris. Men da de hver især begynder at date i smug, begynder også et umuligt forhindringsløb for ikke at blive opdaget.

programme.title: Griffin & Phoenix
programme.desc: Da Griffin får at vide, at han har en dødelig sygdom beslutter han sig for at tage livet i egne hænder og have det sjovt før han dør. Samtidig med at tiden løber ud bliver han forelsket i Phoenix - som også har en hemmelighed.

programme.title: Step Up Revolution
programme.desc: Rigmandsdatteren Emily er ny i Miami, da hun møder den hotte danser, Sean. Han står i spidsen for flash mob-crewet, THE MOB, der gang på gang forvandler byens gader til den vildeste gadefest!

programme.title: Linas aftenbog
programme.desc: Lina er 15 år og går i 9. klasse og har hverken styr på veninderne, fyrene eller sig selv. Hun vil gerne være en af de populære piger i klassen, så da den lidt ældre og tjekkede Danny bliver interesseret i Lina, ser det hele ud til at lykkes.

programme.title: Wedding Daze
programme.desc: Den unge Anderson har opgivet håbet om at finde den rette, efter at han mistede sin kæreste. Da hans kammerat udfordrer ham til at finde kærligheden igen, frier han til den første den bedste pige…

programme.title: Youth In Revolt
programme.desc: Den totalt kiksede, frankofile og 'still-a-virgin', Nick Twisp, bliver sat på sit livs største prøve, da han på en impulsiv flugt-ferie med sin promiskuøse mor og hendes totale taber-kæreste, møder drømmepigen Sheeni i en trailerpark.

programme.title: Beautiful Creatures
programme.desc: 17-årige Ethan drømmer sig langt væk fra sin lille provins-hjemby - indtil han møder den nye pige, Lena.

programme.title: Bandslam
programme.desc: Da highschool nørden Will Burton starter på en ny skole, drømmer han ikke om, hvad der venter. Snart er han involveret i et aparte rockband med ét stort håb: At stille op og vinde i den store rockkonkurrence, Bandslam.

programme.title: We Too Together
programme.desc: Rob kæmper med PTSD efter at være vendt hjem fra krigen. Langsomt lærer han at overvinde sin fortid. I juleferien møder han Gabriela, som han falder pladask for, og hun elsker ham, præcis som han er. Forandringen er total, og livet får igen mening.

programme.title: The Rewrite
programme.desc: Keith Michaels var en dygtig, sexet og Oscar-vindende manuskriptforfatter i Hollywood. Nu, 15 år senere, er han fraskilt, gået fallit og har mistet evnen til at skrive gode manuskripter. Uden andre muligheder tvinges han til at tage et job som underviser på et lille universitet.

programme.title: Personal Effects
programme.desc: Kun én ting kan hele de usynlige sår. Og da Walter vil hævne sin myrdede søster, kommer kærligheden ham i forkøbet.

programme.title: 9 1/2 uge (9½ Weeks)
programme.desc: En kvinde indleder et forhold til en mand, hun dårligt kender. Deres seksuelle eskapader fører til flere og flere forviklinger. Erotisk kultfilm med Oscar-vinderen Kim Basinger og Oscar-nominerede Mickey Rourke

programme.title: De flyvende djævle
programme.desc: Anders Refns prisbelønnede hovedværk om trapezgruppen ’De flyvende djævle’, som består af en far der bestemmer det hele, hans søn og datter og datterens forlovede.

programme.title: Sælgeren
programme.desc: Tvunget ud af deres lejlighed på grund af farligt byggearbejde i nabobygningen, flytter Emad og Rana ind i en lånt lejlighed i centrum af Teheran. En hændelse med bånd tilbage til en tidligere lejer, ændrer det unge pars liv dramatisk.

programme.title: The Greatest
programme.desc: Allen og Grace Brewer har mistet deres ældste søn i en bilulykke, da det pludselig ringer på døren.

programme.title: Lonely Hearts
programme.desc: Lonely Hearts er en fængslende historie om seriemordere på flugt, som er baseret på Martha Beck og Raymond Fernandez' mordtogt i slutningen af 1940erne, og kriminalbetjent Elmer C. Robinsons medvirken i deres tilfangetagelse, fængsling og efterfølgende henrettelse.

programme.title: The Forgiven
programme.desc: Efter apartheidens afslutning mødes ærkebiskop Desmond Tutu med en brutal morder, der søger forløsning.

programme.title: Brothers
programme.desc: Kaptajn Sam Cahill (Maguire) er på vej på sin fjerde udsendelse og efterlader sin elskede kone (Portman) og to døtre. Da Sams Blackhawk-helikopter skydes ned over Afghanistans bjerge, formodes det værste, hvilket efterlader et enormt tomrum i familien.

programme.title: Programmerne genoptages snart
programme.desc: Vi er ved at indhente vores skønhedssøvn! Bliv hængende for mere uvurderlig underholdning udvalgt af Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Another Day of Life
programme.desc: Året er 1975 og Angola hærges af borgerkrig. Militære faktioner strides om kontrollen af den nyligt uafhængige koloni. Den polske journalist Ryszard Kapuscinski ankommer for at dække konflikten.

programme.title: Jeg, Daniel Blake (I, Daniel Blake)
programme.desc: Daniel Blake har arbejdet som snedker i Newcastle det meste af sit 59-årige liv. For første gang nogensinde har han brug for hjælp fra staten efter at være blevet arbejdsløs pga. sygdom. Daniel møder Katie, der er enlig mor til børnene Daisy og Dylan.

programme.title: The Shack
programme.desc: The Shack er baseret på romanen af samme navn fra New York Times' bestsellerliste og tager os med på en fars opløftende spirituelle rejse. Efter at have oplevet en familietragedie ryger Mack Phillips ud i en dyb depression, som får ham til at betvivle sin inderste tro...

programme.title: Gringa
programme.desc: En utilpasset teenagepige løber hjemmefra og tager til Mexico for at finde den far, hun aldrig har kendt. Sammen erfarer de, at man godt kan samle en familie igen, selv om man kun har alle de manglende brikker.

programme.title: Miss Potter
programme.desc: Beatrix Potter er en 30-årig singlekvinde i en tid, hvor kvindens fineste opgave er at gifte sig opad og aldrig se nedad. Ingen, og da slet ikke Beatrix' familie, kan forstå, at hun hellere vil tegne og fortælle små historier om dyr.

programme.title: The Duchess
programme.desc: En krønike om livet for aristokraten Georgiana, hertuginde af Devonshire, fra det 18. århundrede, der var æret for sit ekstravagante politiske og personlige liv.

programme.title: White Oleander
programme.desc: I et anfald af sygelig jalousi forgifter den kompromisløse og forførende kunstner, Ingrid, sin kæreste. Hun idømmes livsvarigt fængsel og hendes 15-årige datter, Astrid, bliver derefter kastet rundt mellem forskellige plejefamilier. Datteren forsøger desperat at danne sig sin egen identitet.

programme.title: The Company Men
programme.desc: Bobby Walker har drømmejobbet, den fotogene familie og en funklende ny Porsche i garagen. Men da nedskæringer sender både Bobby og hans venner på gaden, må de alle omdefinere deres liv - både som mennesker, ægtemænd og fædre.

programme.title: Bekas
programme.desc: Det er de tidlige 90’ere og Saddam Husseins regime har lagt et stort pres på den kurdiske del af Irak. To hjemløse kurdiske drenge ser Superman i byens første biograf og beslutter sig for at tage til Amerika. For at komme dertil har de har brug for pas, penge og en masse held.

programme.title: Brothers
programme.desc: Kaptajn Sam Cahill (Maguire) er på vej på sin fjerde udsendelse og efterlader sin elskede kone (Portman) og to døtre. Da Sams Blackhawk-helikopter skydes ned over Afghanistans bjerge, formodes det værste, hvilket efterlader et enormt tomrum i familien.

programme.title: Journey's End
programme.desc: Vestfronten, 18. marts 1918. Med et massivt tysk angreb nært forestående rykker et kompagni op til sin 6-dages periode på linjen. Kompagniet ledes af den krigstrætte, hårdt sårede og alkoholiserede kaptajn Stanhope. Kompagniet slutter sig til sekondløjtnant Raleigh, lige færdig med sin træning.

programme.title: Danny Collins
programme.desc: Al Pacino spiller den aldrende 70'er-rockstjerne Danny Collins, der ikke kan lægge det vilde liv på hylden. Men da hans manager finder et 40 år gammelt brev fra John Lennon stilet til Danny, men aldrig leveret, beslutter han at skifte spor og drage ud på en følelsesladet færd...

programme.title: All She Can
programme.desc: Luz Garcia, en gymnasieelev i en glemt by i Texas, ønsker noget andet end de muligheder, der venter hende efter endt uddannelse. Hun har fortjent en billet til optagelse på University of Texas i Austin, men hun har ikke råd til at tage afsted.

programme.title: 10 Years
programme.desc: Hvem blev fed? Hvem blev rig? Hvem blev lækker, og hvem blev bare ved med atvære den samme?

programme.title: The Dresser
programme.desc: På en skæbnesvanger aften under Anden Verdenskrig opfører en gruppe turnerende skuespillere en forestilling af Shakespeares "King Lear" i et lille engelsk egnsteater.

programme.title: De flyvende djævle

programme.title: Mothers and Daughters
programme.desc: Højt oppe i toppen af en ejendom på Manhattan kigger den smarte og tilfredse singlepige Rigby Gray ind i sine naboers lejligheder og liv i sikkert skjul bag sin lange kameralinse og uvidende om, at hendes liv snart vil blive forandret for altid.

programme.title: Sælgeren

programme.title: The Visitor
programme.desc: Oscar-nomineret film. En universitetsprofessor rejser til New York City for at deltage i en konference og finder et ungt par boende i hans lejlighed.

programme.title: Jeg, Daniel Blake (I, Daniel Blake)
programme.desc: Daniel Blake har arbejdet som snedker i Newcastle det meste af sit 59-årige liv. For første gang nogensinde har han brug for hjælp fra staten efter at være blevet arbejdsløs pga. sygdom. Daniel møder Katie, der er enlig mor til børnene Daisy og Dylan.

Kompagniet ledes af den krigstrætte, hårdt sårede og alkoholiserede kaptajn Stanhope. Kompagniet slutter sig til sekondløjtnant Raleigh, lige færdig med sin træning.

programme.desc: En familie på tre generationer samles en weekend for at tilbringe en sidste stund sammen med deres dødeligt syge mor Lily. Konflikterne ulmer under overfladen mellem Lilys døtre Jennifer og Anna, og dybt begravede hemmeligheder truer alle håb om et fredeligt farvel.

programme.title: Palo Alto
programme.desc: High School-eleverne Teddy, April, Fred og Emily er ligesom alle andre på jagt efter noget at lave i Palo Altos kedelige forstadsmiljø.

programme.title: Hairbrained
programme.desc: Da det 14-årige geni/udskud Eli Pettifog bliver afvist på Harvard University, ender han på det knap så fine Whitman College. Det er had ved første blik. Elis 41 år gamle bofælle Leo, en tidligere gambler, hvis verden er braset sammen, er droppet ud af livet for at gå på college.

programme.title: Fat Kid Rules The World
programme.desc: Troy Billings er 17 år gammel, overvægtig og parat til at tage livet af sig selv. Da han prøver at springe ud foran en bus, bliver han reddet af Marcus, en charmerende gademusikant, der er droppet ud af high school.

programme.title: Seeking a Friend for the End of the World
programme.desc: Hvis du fik at vide du havde 21 dagetilbage at leve i, hvad ville du så gøre? Om tre uger vil jorden blive tilintetgjort af en gigantisk meteor, og i panik over dette forlades Dodge (Steve Carell) af sin kone.

programme.title: The Right Kind of Wrong
programme.desc: Leo Palamino er en falleret forfatter, der nu arbejder som opvasker. Han er blevet kendt for sine mange fejl og mangler beskrevet i bloggen hvorfor_du_er_nederen.net, som er en kæmpe succes på nettet - skrevet af hans ekskone.

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: Da en hårdtarbejdende redaktør på The New Yorker (Helen Hunt) følger efter sin søn (Brenton Thwaites) til L.A., efter han er droppet ud af college for at finde sig selv, ender hun med selv at være den, der kastes ud i en fuldstændig forvandling.

programme.title: A Little Something For Your Birthday
programme.desc: En håbefuld modedesigner kæmper for at finde succes og kærlighed. Historien skærer ind i hendes liv én gang om året, altid på samme dato: hendes fødselsdag.

programme.title: MacGruber
programme.desc: Når verdensfreden trues, når terroristerne ligger på lur, når verden har brug for en superhelt med hår som Hillary Clinton... hvem kontakter man? Navnet er MacGruber!

programme.title: Tamara Drewe
programme.desc: Den unge journalist Tama Drewe vender tilbage til sine rødder i en engelsk landsby, for at sælge sit barndomshjem efter sin mors død.

programme.title: Death At A Funeral
programme.desc: For de fleste er begravelser bare noget, der skal overstås, og hvis det stod til Daniel, så sprang han gerne denne dag over, hvor hans far skal stedes til hvile.

programme.title: The Funeral Party
programme.desc: Robert Duvall spiller den gamle, sære eneboer, Felix Bush, der pludselig kommer vadende ind i den by, han ikke har sat en fod i så længe nogen kan huske.

programme.title: Good Kids

programme.title: The Fourth Musketeer
programme.desc: På sin fars vegne rejser den unge d'Artagnan fra landskabet i Gascogne til Paris, hvor han er involveret i et snedigt og meget kompliceret komplot mellem kongens musketerer og kardinal Richelieus vagter.

programme.title: Triassic Hunt
programme.desc: Da to genetisk fremstillede dinosaurer flygter fra laboratoriet, tilkaldes et hold lejesoldater for at fange dem. Men soldaterne indser snart, at dinosaurerne er lige så kloge som mennesker, og så er en vild kattens leg med musen i gang.
